items.headline: China market regulator pushes e-commerce platforms on product quality; Alibaba shares drop

Shares fell as much as 6.3%, the steepest drop in two months. Renewed regulatory scrutiny can raise compliance costs and weigh on the multiple.

items.headline: Tesla cuts 2026 capex to about $20B; shares reverse lower after hours
items.summary: Q3 revenue was $28.05B (roughly in line) and adjusted EPS $0.48 vs $0.45 expected, but Tesla cut full-year capex to about $20B from more than $25B. Shares turned lower after hours (down more than 2% as of 6:09 PM ET) and were reported down nearly 5% premarket, as investors questioned the pace of AI/robotics spending. Sources differ on the revenue consensus ($27.9B to $28.3B), so the revenue result is best read as in line.

items.headline: Tesla call: Optimus ramp 'a year or longer', Cybercab targeted by end of 2026, no SpaceX merger comment
items.summary: Musk said early Optimus production has started at Fremont but reaching 20,000 units a week will take at least a year, and the hand is the hardest part. Cybercab customer availability is targeted by end of 2026. Management declined questions on the proposed SpaceX merger, and the quarter carried a $142M mark-to-market loss on SpaceX holdings. Long-dated timelines and merger uncertainty can weigh on the stock's growth premium. This source is AI-assisted, so verify key figures against Tesla filings.
